explication: TensorFold serves supported text-model families through an OpenAI-compatible API on Apple Silicon (MLX) or NVIDIA GPUs (CUDA). The primary workflow is a client request, prompt preparation and scheduling, model-family inference with optional draft proposals checked for exact decoding, then streamed response tokens. Model acquisition and inspection are separate CLI capabilities. Family-specific implementations use shared engine and kernel layers, while CUDA additionally provides rank coordination. The README documents broader family and backend support than the sampled engine excerpts; links among unsampled family internals are therefore kept at subsystem level.
